This weapon has a unique damage type; inherits bonuses from both Melee and Magic damage
Hold left click to charge the weapon; if the weapon is fully charged, the attack varies
Additionally, this weapon can be Overcharged, causing additional effects to occur
Uncharged attacks with this weapon are disabled
Charged attacks with this weapon vary depending on the amount of Overcharge
Overcharging will additionally drain your HP upon reaching Overcharge thresholds (Will not reduce health below 1)
Charged attacks swing the blade in a colossal arc, inflicting Frostburn for 4 seconds
Second stage charge attacks consume 20 HP, but deal 200% damage and will inflict Shadowflame for 4 seconds
At maximum Overcharge, consume an additional 30 HP but guarantees a critical strike and inflict Hyperburn for 4 seconds
Hyperburn deals powerful damage over time and ignores most resistances

sources.from: 15× Gold Coin, 3× Soul of Light, Pearlwood Sword, Essence of Gold

items.name: Gossamer Needle
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Melee or Magic damage
Attacks with this weapon stab forwards, piercing foes
Right click to dash towards your cursor (4 second cooldown)
Press the Weapon Action Key to unleash Gossamer Storm, healing 15 HP and striking nearby foes 3 times (10 second cooldown)
If Gossamer Storm inflicts a critical strike, gain Alacrity for 5 seconds, increasing attack and movement speed
'Too weak, little ghost...'

sources.from: 5× Stinger, 10× Cobweb, White String, Essence Of The Hallownest

items.name: Hawkmoon
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Ranged or Magic damage
Right click to reload the weapon with 12 rounds
Time the reload perfectly to gain Paracausal Anomaly until all bullets are spent
Paracausal Anomaly increases damage while making all attacks guaranteed critical strikes
'What you call Darkness is the end of your evolution'

sources.from: Essence of the Hawkmoon, Enigmatic Dust

items.name: Legendary Shield
items.tooltip:
This weapon can absorb Weapon Memories without limit, permanently gaining their abilities without consuming slots
Can be equipped as an accessory, granting Weapon Memory benefits to the current held weapon, but reduces outgoing damage by 40% (Original Memories are ignored)
Holding this weapon grants defense proportional to Max HP divided by 6
Using this weapon readies the shield for 2 seconds, causing the next attack to heal HP based on its original unmitigated damage (6 second cooldown)
Damage is still taken while this ability is active; sustained damage is reflected to all nearby foes and reflection potency increases based on defense
While the shield is on cooldown, healing from potions is reduced by 80%
While this weapon is equipped as an accessory, gain Heroic Curse under the effect of applicable damaging debuffs
Heroic Curse negates the damage penalty of equipping the weapon as an accessory and additionally increases defense by 10
When either held or equipped as an accessory, gain a directional dash and enemies are more likely to target you

sources.from: Hero Shield, Essence Of The Shield

items.name: Boltstorm Axe
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Melee or Magic damage
The current Aspected Damage Type influences the weapon's attacks (Can not be used if not Aspected to Melee or Magic)
Right click to activate Gathering Levinstorm, enhancing the weapon's attacks for 8 seconds (30 second cooldown)
Melee: Attacks will throw the weapon at high velocity while ignoring terrain, piercing and causing lightning to radiate from struck foes
While Gathering Levinstorm is active, gain Swiftness and 15% increased critical strike chance
Additionally, during Gathering Levinstorm, critical strikes cause the target to explode, taking the damage again
Magic: Swings will emit powerful mid-ranged lightning towards foes, dealing half damage each
Lightning ignores terrain and has no pierce limit, but split lightning deals 1/2th original damage
While Gathering Levinstorm is active, gain 15% increased damage and critical strike chance
Additionally, during Gathering Levinstorm, lightning critical strikes will cause lightning to strike from above, dealing half critical strike damage
Follow-up lightning can not trigger this effect

sources.from: 8× Shroomite Bar, 4× Hallowed Bar, Pickaxe Axe, Lightning Aura Rod, Essence of Lightning

items.name: Manifestation
items.tooltip:
This weapon has a unique damage type; inherits bonuses from all damage classes at 70% efficiency, but inherits 150% from critical strike chance modifiers
Attacks rapidly sweep in a colossal arc; all critical strike damage is increased by 20%
Taking or dealing damage grants Emotional Turbulence (Critical strikes grant double Emotional Turbulence below 200 HP)
Defeating foes increases Emotional Turbulence by 5% (doubled below 200 HP)
Once Emotional Turbulence is full, automatically gain the buff E.G.O. Manifestation while becoming Invincible for 2 seconds
E.G.O. Manifestation grants 30% increased damage, 40% increased attack speed, and 90% increased movement speed, but reduces defense by 30
If E.G.O. Manifestation is active, unique Great Split attacks can be performed
Execute Great Split: Vertical with right click or Great Split: Horizontal with the Weapon Action Key (Both attacks share a 1 minute cooldown)
Great Split: Vertical will grant Invincibility for 1 second and deal 800% guaranteed close-ranged critical damage after a short delay
Great Split: Horizontal will deal 300% guaranteed critical damage to all foes on the screen after a short delay
Both Great Split attacks will execute any non-boss enemy below 30% HP and additionally refill Emotional Turbulence to full upon activation
If E.G.O. Manifestation is active, Emotional Turbulence will passively decrease over time (Resets when not holding the weapon)
The longer E.G.O. Manifestation lasts, the faster Emotional Turbulence will drain
If Emotional Turbulence is below 10% for 3 seconds, E.G.O. Manifestation will end and you will be inflicted with Vulnerability for 10 seconds
'Let's start this for real- I'll crush you all...'

sources.from: 10× Hallowed Bar, 10× Soul of Fright, 40× Flesh Block, 30× Vertebra, 8× Tissue Sample, Broken Hero Sword, Demi-Essence of Mimicry

Using this weapon marks a location based on your cursor (1 minute cooldown)
While cooldown is active, defense and attack are reduced by 5%
After 3 seconds, an orbital train will annihilate your marked location, dealing guaranteed critical damage to all foes caught in the crossfire
This attack ignores terrain and destroys projectiles it makes contact with
The first foe struck by this attack will additionally take 50% increased damage
Inherits 10% of the Stellar Nova's scaled base damage
'Cookie powered'

sources.from: v:4017, Minecart, 8× Fallen Star, Essence Of Mew

items.name: Phasmasaber
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Ranged or Melee damage
The current Aspected Damage Type influences this weapon's attacks (Can not be used if not Aspected to Ranged or Melee)
Critical strikes from this weapon inflict Shadowflame for 3 seconds
Right click to activate Spectral Illusion for 12 seconds, activating a unique effect based on the current Aspected Damage Type (60 second cooldown)
During Spectral Illusion, this weapon's damage type is changed to Chionic, inheriting bonuses from both Ranged and Melee damage at 120% efficiency
Additionally, striking foes inflicted with Shadowflame will enhance the debuff into Spiritflame, which inherits the remaining duration of Spectral Illusion
Melee: The weapon can be channeled, orbiting and striking nearby foes at close range for 300% damage (Range can be adjusted with mouse cursor)
While Spectral Illusion is active, the weapon will follow your cursor when channeled, spinning and emitting sweeping shadowflame beams
Ranged: Attacks swing the weapon in an arc, spreading damaging crystals
While Spectral Illusion is active, the weapon will orbit the cursor when channeled, firing crystals towards it
Pressing the Weapon Action Key while Spectral Illusion is active will remove the buff and execute Spectral Phantasm, a special attack based on the current Aspected Damage Type
Melee: Spectral Phantasm causes the weapon to violently explode on your cursor, dealing 400% guaranteed critical strike damage to all nearby foes while inflicting Spiritflame for 10 seconds
Ranged: Spectral Phantasm horizontally slashes across the screen based on cursor position, dealing 800% guaranteed critical strike damage to all foes in its wake
'Rainbows are visions, but only illusions'

sources.from: 8× Hallowed Bar, 12× Glowing Mushroom, 2× Soul of Night, 12× Crystal Shard, Essence Of Chionic Energy

items.name: Soliloquy Of Sovereign Seas
items.tooltip:
This weapon has a unique damage type; inherits bonuses from both Magic and Summon damage
Gain up to 30 bonus damage based on percentage of HP above 60% Max HP
Press the Weapon Action Key to swap Arkhe Alignment between Pneuma and Ousia, changing this weapon's abilities
While attuned to Pneuma, right click to summon the Singer of Seas, consuming 1 minion slot (Only one Singer of Seas can be summoned at a time)
The Singer of Seas will heal all allies in a wide radius for 2% of this weapon's damage every 5 seconds (Increased to 5% below 200 HP; does not heal if afflicted with Potion Sickness)
While attuned to Ousia, right click to summon 3 Salon Attendants, consuming 1 minion slot (Only one group of Salon Attendants can be summoned at a time)
The Salon Attendants automatically attack nearby foes with homing bolts
Gain Waterwalking while summons are present
Summons will disappear when swapping Arkhe Alignment
'Let the world come alive!'

sources.from: 10× Sapphire, 12× Prismatic Core, Essence Of Hydro

items.name: Sunset of the Sun God
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty
Right click to unleash Vasavi Shakti, leaping into the air, gaining Featherfall and Invincibility for 2 seconds (1 minute cooldown)
Vasavi Shakti channels a powerful beam of energy towards your cursor for 2 seconds
Vasavi Shakti will conclude with a colossal explosion, dealing 200% guaranteed critical damage and inflicting Daybroken for 8 seconds
The current Aspected Damage Type influences the weapon's attacks (Weapon can not be used without Aspected Damage Type)
Melee: Rapidly stab in a close-ranged flurry; Charged attacks swing in a wide arc, burning foes for 8 seconds
Magic: Lightning spears converge on your cursor after a delay, causing lightning to arc from foes struck
Ranged: Attacks launch the spear at high velocity, dealing 200% damage and piercing infinitely without damage falloff
Summon: Attacks extend a burning whip, inflicting Daybroken for 2 seconds on hit
'With this single strike, I shall inflict extinction!'

items.name: Wolvesbane
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Ranged or Melee damage
Attacks with this weapon fire quick blasts (Critical strike damage is increased by 20% for 3 seconds after a critical strike)
Right click to fire Pulse Impact, dealing 200% guaranteed critical strike damage in a small explosion (Charges Wolf Pulse by 50% on explosion) (4 second cooldown)
Attacks charge Wolf Pulse when striking foes
Once Wolf Pulse is above 50%, press the Weapon Action Key to unsheathe the Wolvesbane, consuming 50% Wolf Pulse
The Wolvesbane will strike at nearby foes and unleash a powerful shockwave, dealing 300% damage as a guaranteed critical strike
Damage is halved after every pierce
Additionally, gain Wrath for 4 seconds after Wolvesbane is unleashed

items.name: Wolvesbane Awakened
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Ranged or Melee damage
Attacks with this weapon swing in a wide arc, strike multiple times, and critical strike damage is increased by 50%
Right click to dash forward and stab with the blade, exploding and dealing a guaranteed critical strike while gaining Invincibility for a short duration (8 second cooldown)
This attack charges Wolf Pulse by 50% on hit
Attacks charge Wolf Pulse when striking foes (Critical strikes charge Wolf Pulse faster)
Once Wolf Pulse is at 100%, press the Weapon Action Key to dash forward, activating Wolvesbane's Legacy, consuming all Wolf Pulse and gaining Invincibility for 2 seconds
Wolvesbane's Legacy unleashes powerful slashes and finishes with an explosive projectile that bursts into a huge explosion, dealing 400% guaranteed critical strike damage
Additionally, gain Wrath while this weapon is held

sources.from: 12× v:3458, 12× v:3456, 8× Hallowed Bar, Wolvesbane Rearmed

items.name: Wolvesbane Rearmed
items.tooltip:
This weapon is unaffected by Aspected Damage Type penalty when aspected to Ranged or Melee damage
Attacks with this weapon fire quick blasts (Critical strike damage is increased by 50% for 6 seconds after a critical strike)
Right click to fire Pulse Impact, dealing 200% guaranteed critical damage in a small explosion (Charges Wolf Pulse by 50% on explosion) (4 second cooldown)
Attacks charge Wolf Pulse when striking foes
Once Wolf Pulse is above 50%, press the Weapon Action Key to unsheathe the Wolvesbane, consuming 50% Wolf Pulse and gaining Invincibility for a short duration
The Wolvesbane will strike at nearby foes and unleash a powerful shockwave, dealing 300% damage as a guaranteed critical strike
Damage is halved after every pierce
Additionally, gain Wrath while this weapon is held

items.name: Ashen Ambition
items.tooltip:
Attacks pierce foes and have no knockback
Right click to disappear, activating Ashen Execution and saving your cursor's position (1 minute cooldown)
After a short delay, teleport to your cursor and deal damage around you, instantly executing foes below this weapon's base damage * 5
Foes below the execution threshold will glow
Defeating foes in this manner instantly refreshes the cooldown of Ashen Execution (2 second minimum) and grants one stack of Call of the Void
Each stack of Call of the Void increases movement speed by 5%
At 5 stacks of Call of the Void all stacks are reset and Ashen Execution has a 10 second cooldown
Additionally, gain Ashen Strength for 2 seconds, drastically restoring HP and increasing damage by 20%
Failing to execute an enemy resets all stacks of Call of the Void
'Put these foolish ambitions to rest'

sources.from: 6× Ruby, 12× Crimtane Bar, Essence of Ash
6× Ruby, 12× Demonite Bar, Essence of Ash

items.name: The Blood Blade
items.tooltip:
Attacks with this weapon will rapidly sweep in an arc
Striking foes with this attack will heal a small portion of damage dealt as HP (Max 5 HP)
Gain the buff Bloodthirsting Blade when wielding this weapon
Bloodthirsting Blade grants powerful buffs as HP diminishes, but prevents natural life regeneration
Damage, critical strike chance, and critical strike damage is increased based on missing HP
Damage bonuses cap at 200% damage
Right click to unleash Blade Art: Dragon, consuming 20% of current HP (20 second cooldown)
After a short delay during which you are invulnerable, Blade Art: Dragon activates
Blade Art: Dragon deals 400% damage to all foes in a wide radius around you
Defeating a foe with Blade Art: Dragon instantly refreshes the cooldown
'So, let all become ash!'

sources.from: 6× Hallowed Bar, 8× Soul of Fright, 2× Black Fairy Dust, Essence of Lifethirsting

items.name: Burning Desire
items.tooltip:
Attacks stab in a rapid combo, striking multiple times and finishing with a downward swing
The third strike only strikes once, but deals 20% bonus damage and grants a stack of Power Strike
Power Strike increases damage by 5% and defense by 5 per stack (Up to 5)
At maximum stacks of Power Strike, right click to consume all stacks, entering Boiling Blood for 15 seconds
During Boiling Blood, gain 30% increased damage and 30 defense, but health regeneration is disabled and HP will slowly drain over time (Will not drop below 1)
Additionally, gain attack speed based on missing HP, and attacks become empowered with explosive follow-up attacks
Right click during Boiling Blood to activate Boiling Burst, ending Boiling Blood
Boiling Burst deals damage in a colossal area around you based on missing health and 1/4th damage dealt during Boiling Blood
Additionally, become Extinguished for 20 seconds, preventing the activation of Boiling Blood
'My blood's only going to make this place hotter!'

sources.from: Butcher's Chainsaw, 3× Chain, Lava Bucket, 8× Luminite Bar, 18× v:3458, Essence of the Overwhelming Blaze

items.name: Claimh Solais
items.tooltip:
Critical strikes with this weapon will grant a stack of Radiance (Up to 10)
Right click with 5 stacks of Radiance to unleash the Radiant Soul, consuming all Radiance
When the Radiant Soul is unleashed, gain 1 second of Invincibility
The Radiant Soul will deal powerful critical damage to nearby foes in a large radius
The Radiant Soul's damage is influenced by a portion of defense and current stacks of Radiance
Gaining Radiance past 10 stacks will instead grant Ironskin for 4 seconds
'An indefatigable sword- its blade glitters with light'

sources.from: 3× Life Fruit, Broken Hero Sword, 12× Soul of Light, Eye of the Golem, Essence of Radiance

items.name: Crimson Sakura Alpha
items.tooltip:
Striking foes cause Skill Orbs to drop
Right click after picking up a Skill Orb to unleash a special ability
Skill Orbs last for 20 seconds after picking them up and do not stack
Pick up a Red Orb to unleash Flickering Strike: Slash the area around you in a wide attack for double damage
Pick up a Blue Orb to unleash Lightbreak Strike: All melee attacks become critical strikes for 2 seconds
Pick up a Yellow Orb to unleash Dazzling Strike: Pierce foes with a ranged burst
Right clicking with multiple orbs will use the orbs in the order you acquired them
After using all 3 orbs in quick succession, right click to enter Blade Will
Blade Will drains mana constantly, and has a 60 second cooldown upon conclusion
During Blade Will, attack much faster and fire projectiles when you attack
Blade Will ends once Mana reaches 0, and Mana can not be regenerated
The longer you stay in Blade Will, the more Mana upkeep is required
Instead of Skill Orbs, attacking foes will drop Blade Orbs which prolong Blade Will through granting Mana
Blade Will's projectiles will not spawn Blade Orbs
You are unable to use special abilities while under Blade Will
'This is the final journey'

sources.from: 12× Hallowed Bar, 12× Shroomite Bar, Essence of the Alpha

items.name: Drachenlance
items.tooltip:
Use right click to perform a Jump into the air (12 second cooldown) and become imbued with the Blood of the Dragon for 5 seconds
You will also be granted Featherfall for 1 second
Blood of the Dragon will apply the following effects:
During Blood of the Dragon, the next attack will launch you towards your cursor after Featherfall ends
Additionally, damage is increased by 40%, movement speed is increased, and fall damage is negated
After two instances of Blood of the Dragon, the next Jump will instead grant Life of the Dragon for 8 seconds
Life of the Dragon will apply the following effects:
During Life of the Dragon, the next attack will fire a barrage of draconic fireballs that lower enemy defense
Additionally, damage and critical strike chance is increased by 60% and fall damage is negated
After the initial attack, every attack will launch you towards your target, dealing high amounts of bonus damage and granting Invincibility for 1 second
Jump counters will be reset when swapping off this weapon
'Born amidst the timeless conflict between men and dragons, forged that they might better pierce the scaled hides of their mortal foes'

sources.from: 33× Hallowed Bar, 12× Soul of Sight, Essence of the Dragonslayer

items.name: Hullwrought
items.tooltip:
Hold left click to charge the weapon; if the weapon is fully charged, the attack varies
Right click to swap between Blasting Form and Striking Form with 1/3rd second cooldown
In Striking Form, attacks focus on close-ranged damage
Uncharged attacks will slash in a huge area
Charged attacks propel you forward while swinging in a large circle around you, dealing double damage
In Blasting Form, attacks focus on slow, powerful ranged attacks
Uncharged attacks are disabled
Charged attacks take much longer to perform, but instead fires a powerful projectile that stuns foes for 1/3rd second on a critical strike
Holding charge attack enhances the attack every 1/2 second, capping at 10 stacks
If the charged attack has 5 stacks or more, it will always be a critical strike

sources.from: 5× Prismatic Core, 8× Hallowed Bar, Essence of the Gunlance

items.name: Hullwrought MK. II
items.tooltip:
Hold left click to charge the weapon; if the weapon is fully charged, the attack varies
Right click to swap between Blasting Form, Striking Form, and Mystic Form with 1/3rd second cooldown
In Striking Form, attacks focus on close-ranged damage
Uncharged attacks will slash in a huge area
Charged attacks propel you forward while swinging in a large circle around you, dealing double damage
In Blasting Form, attacks focus on slow, powerful ranged attacks
Uncharged attacks are disabled
Charged attacks take much longer to perform, but instead fires a powerful projectile that stuns foes for 1/3rd second on a critical strike
Holding charge attack enhances the attack every 1/2 second, capping at 10 stacks
If the charged attack has 5 stacks or more, it will always be a critical hit
In Mystic Form, attacks focus on magical burst attacks, costing 20 Mana per shot
Uncharged attacks fire weak homing projectiles
Charged attacks fire powerful blasts of energy that travel slowly and deal damage over time
Charged attacks require 80 Mana
Gain Mana Regeneration when not in Mystic Form

Defeating foes will heal 5 HP

items.name: Liberation Blazing
items.tooltip:
Swapping to this weapon grants the buff 'Core of Flames' for 20 seconds
This buff has a 2 minute cooldown, beginning when Core of Flames is applied
When you are under the influence of Core of Flames attacks cause a massive explosion on contact, burning foes for 3 seconds
When the weapon is held without Core of Flames active, you will be burned until the blade is stowed

Scarlet Outburst inflicts 50 unmitigatable self damage and burns you for 8 seconds

This healing is only applicable with this weapon held

sources.from: 20× Prismatic Core, 8× v:3458, Essence of Liberation

items.name: Maniacal Justice
items.tooltip:
Attacks with this weapon strikes foes multiple times with a close-ranged slash
Striking foes grant 1 LV (Critical strikes grant 5 LV instead)
Right click to unleash a SLAUGHTERING SLASH at your cursor after a short delay, dealing 300% damage in a vertical slash (6 second cooldown)
Additionally, the SLAUGHTERING SLASH grants 2 LV per hit
LV caps at 100 and will deplete quickly out of combat
Taking damage resets LV but reduces damage taken based on amount of LV
At 20 LV, attack speed is increased by 20% and the cooldown of SLAUGHTERING SLASH is halved
At 50 LV, attack speed is increased by an additional 10% and all attacks will now inflict Karmic Retribution for 10 seconds, dealing damage over time
At 100 LV, all bonuses are removed, but pressing the Weapon Action Key will unleash a SPECIAL ATTACK for 15 seconds, consuming all LV
During the SPECIAL ATTACK attack speed and damage dealt is doubled and attacks are guaranteed critical strikes but damage taken is tripled
Additionally, gain infinite flight time and a 25% chance to dodge any attack
Once the SPECIAL ATTACK concludes, this weapon can not be used for 30 seconds

sources.from: Psycho Knife, 12× Bone, Bone Sword, Essence of Mania

items.name: Memento Muse
items.tooltip:
Holding this weapon will cause the Rhythm Gauge to appear
Swing in tandem with the beat to deal increased damage and fire a powerful projectile
Keeping up with with the rhythm will slowly increase critical hit ratio
The combo has a limit of 12
Once you have completed a combo, you will gain the ability to use a Rhythm Burst
Right click with Rhythm Burst ready to temporarily ignore timing for 2 seconds
Rhythm Burst will reset your combo to 0
'I'm not asking for much- do me a favor and die?'

sources.from: 7× Hallowed Bar, 14× Soul of Night, Essence of Death's Apprentice

items.name: Mercy
items.tooltip:
Attacks with this weapon will rapidly sweep in a short-ranged arc
Right click to unleash Edge of Anguish (12 second cooldown)
Edge of Anguish will target the nearest enemy to your cursor and charge towards them
Gain Invincibility for the duration of the dash and striking foes deals 300% damage		
Upon contact, inflict Infernal Hemorrhage for 3 seconds, dealing powerful damage over time
Additionally, deal 10% of the foe's missing HP as bonus true damage (Up to 2000)
Critical strikes with this weapon's basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Edge of Anguish by 1 second
Allies striking foes under the influence of Infernal Hemorrhage with projectiles grants Rage for 8 seconds
Additionally, these attacks deal 2% of the foe's missing HP as bonus true damage (Up to 250)
'From the depths of Noxian streets'

sources.from: 15× Hallowed Bar, Bloody Tear, Essence of Blood

items.name: Misery's Company
items.tooltip:

Blade Mode allows for quick swings at close range
Scythe Mode throws a scythe with very long reach that can bypass walls with a cooldown
Shotgun Mode fires bullets in a spread pattern that does not use ammo, doing half damage per shot

items.name: Naganadel
items.tooltip:
Use right click to expend 25 mana, summoning up to 5 Aspected Blades
Blades deal minor contact damage while idle
Attack with blades present to launch them towards the cursor
Use right click once all blades are summoned to launch all blades at once, dealing random effects
Each blade has unique effects:
The Stardust Aspect will restore 20 mana on hit, but deals half damage
The Vortex Aspect travels faster and farther, deals 600% damage on a critical hit and grants Swiftness
The Solar Aspect burns foes on hit and deals double damage to flaming enemies, but travels slower and has less range
The Nebula Aspect summons a barrage of falling stars from the sky on hit
Naganadel costs 50 mana to summon instead, but will apply most other effects with a lunar bonus effect
If the destination is closer than the maximum range, the blades will deal residual damage as they fade away
Blades will vanish when swapping weapons
'I have no regrets. This is the only path'

sources.from: 20× Luminite Bar, 20× v:3456, Essence of Lunar Dominion

items.name: Penthesilea's Muse
items.tooltip:
Attacks with this weapon will sweep in a wide arc
Every 15 seconds, the nearest boss enemy will be Inked and will drip paint according to a specific color
Right click to view all Mystic Pigments
Selecting a Mystic Pigment will change your attacks to the specified color
Striking Inked foes with the correct Mystic Pigment will always crit
Striking Inked foes with the wrong color will deal half damage, and the opposite color will deal 1/3rd damage
Additionally, each Mystic Pigment has a special debuff when striking foes that lasts for 4 seconds
Red Pigment inflicts On Fire / Green Pigment inflicts Cursed Flame
Orange Pigment inflicts Ichor / Blue Pigment inflicts Frostburn
Yellow Pigment inflicts Midas / Purple Pigment inflicts Acid Venom

sources.from: Paintbrush, 12× Chlorophyte Bar, Essence of Ink

items.name: Clarent Rebellion
items.tooltip:
Attacks with this weapon cleave nearby foes and grants Rage for 8 seconds on hit
Holding this weapon amplifies the effects of Rage, Endurance, and Ironskin by 50%
Dealing or taking damage grants stacks of Rebellion (Rebellion is lost out of combat)
At certain thresholds of Rebellion, manifest portions of the Crimson Armor, gaining 5 defense per armor
Once Rebellion is at maximum and all portions of the Crimson Armor are equipped, increase defense further and gain access to Clarent Blood Arthur
Additionally, gain a 3rd combo attack and striking foes now burst into red lightning (3rd combo strike empowers lightning)
Right click to unleash Clarent Blood Arthur, dealing 200% damage in a powerful burst towards your cursor after a delay (1 minute cooldown)
Additionally, this attack is a guaranteed critical strike against bosses

sources.from: 8× Soul of Might, Excalibur, Warrior Emblem, Essence Of Kingslaying

items.name: Rex Lapis
items.tooltip:
Attacks with this weapon execute rapid stabs
Each attack grants Bulwark of Jade for 2 seconds on hit, increasing defenses by 30
Right click to consume 150 mana, dropping a colossal earthen meteor from the heavens, dealing 200% damage (20 second cooldown)
Additionally, this attack will deal bonus damage based on 50% of your Max HP
This meteor will apply Petrification to foes struck on a critical strike, drastically crippling their movement speed for 3 seconds
Attacking Petrified foes with this weapon will deal extra damage
Critical strikes will Shatter foes that are Petrified
Shatter deals 500% damage while removing Petrification
'I will have order!'

sources.from: 12× v:3458, 3× v:3456, Essence of the Unyielding Earth

items.name: Sakura's Vengeance
items.tooltip:
Every 30 seconds, the weapon cycles through 4 Elemental Arts
Earthsplitter increases defense by 10 and grants 25% damage resistance
Attacks stun enemies for 1 second (Critical strikes stun enemies for 4 seconds and grant Invincibility briefly)
Heavenly Volley increases attack and movement speed by 20% 
Attacks are accompanied by falling stars that inflict Ichor for 8 seconds
Cooling Haze increases Health and Mana Regeneration and inflicts Frostburn for 2 seconds on hit
Nearby foes are inflicted with Frostburn until they leave the radius
Volcanic Wrath increases attack and critical strike chance by 20% and inflicts On Fire for 2 seconds on hit
Defeating foes will cause them to explode into a shower of flames, inflicting Cursed Flame for 8 seconds
Holding this weapon will cause the Vengeance Gauge to appear
Defeating foes with this weapon will fill the Vengeance Gauge
Right click to consume the Vengeance Gauge and gain the buff Elemental Chaos for 14 seconds
